story: The kite flies over a website and scans it with a light beam -> red pins pop onto broken spots -> a score card with a ring gauge pops up -> the kite flies back -> loop.
caption: Scan → score → fixes

keyframe-reference.png.use: image reference for the pins and score card

picked.model: seedance_2_5 (Seedance 2.5), mode omni_reference, 7 s, 720p, no audio
picked.why: Scan beam, three clear pins on cracks, a readable ring score card, kite stays on model.

rejected.why: Pins are tiny and the score card reads as a speedometer.
Kite flattens into a sliver for a few frames near the end.

web.edit: full clip, 0.6 s dissolve from the end into the start for a seamless loop

files.explainer.mp4: H.264 high, 960x540, 24 fps, 6.4 s, CRF 27, faststart, no audio, 245 KB
files.explainer-poster.webp: pins + kite + score card frame, 30 KB

takes: takes/*_sheet.jpg are contact sheets (one frame every 0.5 s) of every take, kept for review
